title: 第2章 无限寿命，人生祸福难料
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
面对陈礼等人不善的目光，以及同门惊疑的目光，姜长生并没有慌乱。
他反而问道：“没错，我就是练的脚法，但敢问陈施主如何知晓，我观内弟子上百，你怎么就确定我会，莫非你已经检查完所有弟子？”
不到一个时辰，检查上百位弟子的武学，太紧凑了，除非对方打定主意凶手来自龙起观。
陈礼摇头道：“自然不是，只是昨夜下过雨，一个时辰前才停，虽不大，但漫上山皆是泥泞，弟子们若是昨夜没有外出，今日过来，靴子上的泥土应该还未干，所有人皆是如此，唯有你，连裤腿上也有凝干的泥土，说明昨晚你的双腿进行过大幅度的动作。”
姜长生低头看去，确实如此，裤腿上有大小不一的诸多泥斑。
殿外弟子们骚动起来，窃窃私语。
他依旧不慌，看向陈礼，问道：“脚法猜测说得过去，但我的杀人动机呢，我从小便生活在龙起观，未曾出去过，这几日里也没有与你们接触过，我为何要杀他？”
清虚道长面无表情，三位大弟子则若有所思。
就连陈礼背后的五位宾客也低声讨论起来。
为何要杀？
一名富家千金开口道：“对啊，他是死在自己的房间里，若是这位小道长所杀，他深夜进人房间杀人，那得是多大的仇恨？”
景朝风气开明，女子也是可以外出的，这位富家千金并非与陈礼同行，只是刚好这段时间来龙起观修道静心，她的奴仆们都在殿外候着。
姜长生开始打量陈礼等人，他觉得凶手大概率在这些人之中。
这家伙体内有真气！
姜长生敏锐的捕捉到一名存在感极低的干瘦男子，道法自然功乃是修仙功法，他虽没有修炼出灵力来，但他的感官异常灵敏，远超凡人。
干瘦男子一副商人打扮，身子瘦弱，让人很难想到他是习武之人，而且他的真气很微弱，很难发现，但躲不过姜长生的感官。
这些细微的真气是从一些穴道部位散出来的，也就是说这厮是将真气封印于穴道之中，形成自己不会武功的假象。
陈礼皱眉道：“确实没有动机，但只是我们不知道动机，追查过往关系以及证据，就不能单纯的依靠说辞定论，需要衙门调查，不知小道长可愿……”
姜长生突然打断问道：“陈施主先前说你身后这些人都不会武功，是吗？”
陈礼点头道：“没错，你的三位师兄、师姐都检查过。”

那说明他们武功不到家！
怎么不是师父检查？
他不敢多问，怕薄了清虚道长的颜面。
姜长生问道：“可否让我检查一番？”
陈礼警惕，道：“不妥，毕竟我们现在怀……”
话还未说完，姜长生突然身形一晃，化为一道道残影，掠过陈礼，杀至那位干瘦男子面前，抬手抓去，哪知干瘦男子反应极快，竟迅速跳开，躲过他的手。
陈礼回头，见到这一幕不由瞪大眼睛，其他四位宾客也是如此。
他们之中竟然有人会武功！
殿外的奴仆们连忙冲进来，将其包围。
干瘦男子不复先前的紧张神色，而是露出凶狠笑容，他盯着姜长生，笑道：“小道士，没想到你的道行如此高，连我的功法都能看破，看来你还真是奇才。”
姜长生平静道：“阁下的身法也不简单。”
富家千金后退，惊恐的问道：“薛海，你怎会武功？”
薛海阴恻恻笑道：“你很了解我？”
富家千金沉默。
薛海看向陈礼，道：“状元郎，是不是很讽刺，若非对方武功高强，你是不是要强抓他，回到衙门再随便定罪？陈家一贯如此，楚朝尚在时，你们便是如此。”
楚朝，那是景朝之前的朝代，楚朝末年，宦官乱政，民不聊生，有义士揭竿起义，导致楚朝崩坏，天下迎来诸侯割据时代，姜渊并非士族，只是一名习武之人，但他成功的建立了景朝。
武夫当帝，景朝迎来习武之风，风气远超历代皇朝。
陈礼皱眉问道：“薛海，你为何要杀他？”
薛海没有回答，突然杀向陈礼，速度极快。
姜长生没有动，因为他看陈礼也不爽，这厮乱扣帽子，想带他去衙门。

“哼！”
清虚道长冷哼一声，一步来到陈礼面前，抬掌打去，与薛海的右掌相击，薛海手骨寸断，吐血倒飞出去，撞破门窗，惊得外面的弟子后退。
这厮竟然会掌法，那他为何用腿法行凶？
姜长生突然觉得薛海是故意陷害他。
莫非他之前练功时被薛海撞见？
薛海落地后，迅速跳起，一跃数丈高，直接消失在庭院外。
“跟我追！”
二师兄孟秋河冲出去喊道，当即就有数十名弟子跟着跑出庭院。
陈礼惊魂未定，差点瘫坐在地上。
清虚道长收掌，扶住他的肩膀，道：“陈施主，天下虽定，仍暗流涌动，你作为景朝第一位状元，不该随意走动，今日之劫，日后还得反复。”
陈礼连忙拜谢，随后又向姜长生道歉，见他态度诚恳，姜长生也没有刁难。
事情就此结束，姜长生成了焦点，那些没有追凶的弟子纷纷围上来，询问他刚才用的是什么武功，好快。
就连大师兄李长青、二师兄孟秋河也感兴趣。
清虚道长开口道：“长生，以后你不用来例常听道，你可自行习武，除了晨间敲钟，你的日常你自己定。”
此言一出，弟子们皆是羡慕的看向他，包括李长青、孟秋河，两位大弟子还得教导师弟、师妹们。
姜长生愣了愣，然后拜谢清虚道长。
清虚道长转身离去，殿外的弟子们立即围进来。
应付同门好一会儿，姜长生找到机会离去，连那位富家千金都对他感兴趣，实在是顶不住。
凶案暂时落下，至于凶手有没有被抓到，那就不关姜长生的事，其他弟子照常修行，他回到自己的舍院，只有他一人。
在龙起观，一院四房，一房两名弟子居住。

坐在床榻上，姜长生开始整理思绪。
他一直不确定清虚道长是否知晓他的真实身份，将他带入龙起观后，清虚道长也没有特别照顾他，他总不能直接去询问。
今日之事，涉及前朝，暴露武学后，清虚道长竟然给了他最大的自由，这就让他浮想联翩。
【开元十二年，你偶遇前朝余孽行凶，你被拉入祸端中，你凭借着你的本领摆脱危难，获得生存奖励——武学‘金刚啸’】
一条只有他能看见的文字出现在眼前，让他露出笑容。
又度过一劫！
若非他六年如一日的修行武学，今日无法将薛海逼出本领来，怕是要被抓去衙门，再被那些权贵阴死。
“以后还是要努力修行，不能懈怠，今日之事说明只要有正当的理由，朝堂还是能有办法将我带出去。”
姜长生默默想到。
他还想到一点，清虚道长真的看不透薛海会武功？
不管怎样，他不能选择相信别人，只能相信自己。
姜长生想通后，开始学习脑海里多出的金刚啸武学。
金刚啸是一种真气刺激喉咙经脉的武学，能让声音变得异常大，从而震伤敌人，练至大成，还能驱除邪祟。
邪祟二字让他心里一紧，看来这世上莫非有鬼怪？
也是，他都投胎了，有鬼怪也不奇怪。
接下来数日，姜长生被烦透了，弟子们对于他极为好奇，他白天几乎把时间花在应付同门身上，夜晚还会遇到同门偷窥，同舍比姜长生小一岁的师弟还纠缠他，无奈之下，他将九寻天龙步的基础步法传授于他，这才没有再纠缠他。
日子终于清静下来，姜长生正在屋内修炼道法自然功。
哐当——
师弟青苦跑进来，兴奋道：“师兄，那位状元郎又来了，点明要来拜谢你，师父已经同意，他已经来到庭院外，见吗？”
姜长生皱眉道：“不见，就说他不必谢我。”

青苦愣了愣，他从小跟着姜长生长大，在大事上还是很听姜长生的话，于是点头，转身向屋外走去。
“哈哈哈，小道长，看来你这是记仇了，确实是我当时唐突了，我特地来赔礼道歉，还附赠我陈家的武学，望你接纳。”
只见陈礼抬步走进来，满脸热情的笑容，十一岁的青苦根本拦不住。
姜长生无奈道：“你现在也很唐突。”
陈礼自顾自地坐下，从怀中掏出一本金线蓝皮的秘籍，放在桌上。
“此武学名为气指，需要修炼出真气才能修行，奈何我陈家在百年前便由武转文，之后再无习武奇才，今日便赠予小道长。”
陈礼笑着介绍道，提起家族历史，他的语气有些嘘唏。
在尚武的景朝，陈家生存得很艰难。
content_en:
Facing the unkind looks from Chen Li and others, as well as the suspicious looks from his fellow disciples, Jiang Changsheng did not panic.
Instead, he asked: "Yes, I just practice the footwork, but I dare to ask Master Chen how he knows. I have hundreds of disciples in the temple. How can you be sure that I can do it? Could it be that you have already checked all the disciples?"
In less than an hour, checking the martial arts of hundreds of disciples was too tight, unless the opponent made up his mind that the murderer came from Long Qiguan.
Chen Li shook his head and said: "Of course not. It just rained last night and stopped an hour ago. Although it is not heavy, the mountains are covered with mud. If the disciples did not go out last night and come today, the mud on the boots should not be dry yet. This is the case for everyone. Only you. There is dried mud on your trouser legs, which means that your legs made a lot of movements last night."
Jiang Changsheng looked down and saw that it was indeed true. There were many mud spots of different sizes on the trouser legs.
The disciples outside the hall became commotion and whispered.
He still didn't panic, looked at Chen Li, and asked: "The speculation about footwork is reasonable, but what about my motive for killing? I have lived in Longqiguan since I was a child and have never been out. I have not been in contact with you in the past few days. Why should I kill him?"
Taoist Master Qingxu's face was expressionless, while the three disciples were thoughtful.
Even the five guests behind Chen Li started discussing in low voices.
Why kill?
A wealthy daughter said: "Yes, he died in his room. If he was killed by this little Taoist priest, he entered the room late at night and killed people. How much hatred would it be?"
The atmosphere in Jing Dynasty was open and women were allowed to go out. This wealthy daughter was not traveling with Chen Li, but she happened to come to Longqi Temple to practice Taoism and meditate during this period. Her servants were waiting outside the temple.
Jiang Changsheng began to look at Chen Li and others. He felt that the murderer was most likely among these people.
This guy has real energy in his body!
Jiang Changsheng keenly captured a skinny man with a very low sense of existence. The Taoist Natural Technique is a cultivation technique for immortality. Although he has not cultivated spiritual power, his senses are extremely sensitive, far beyond ordinary people.
The skinny man was dressed like a businessman, and his body was so thin that it was difficult for people to think that he was a martial arts practitioner. Moreover, his Qi was very weak and difficult to detect, but it could not be hidden from Jiang Changsheng's senses.
These tiny amounts of true energy are emitted from some acupuncture points, which means that this guy has sealed the true energy in the acupoints, creating the illusion that he doesn't know martial arts.
Chen Li frowned and said: "There is indeed no motive, but we just don't know the motive. To trace the past relationships and evidence, we can't just rely on words to make a conclusion. We need an investigation by the Yamen. I don't know if the Taoist leader is willing..."
Jiang Changsheng suddenly interrupted and asked: "Donor Chen said before that these people behind you don't know martial arts, right?"
Chen Li nodded and said, "Yes, your three senior brothers and sisters have all checked it."
That means they are not good at martial arts!
Why isn't it being inspected by Master?
He didn't dare to ask any more questions for fear of damaging Taoist Master Qingxu's face.
Jiang Changsheng asked: "Can you let me check it?"
Chen Li was wary and said: "It's not appropriate, after all, we are pregnant now..."
Before he finished speaking, Jiang Changsheng suddenly swayed and turned into afterimages, passing by Chen Li and reaching the skinny man. He raised his hand to grab him. Unexpectedly, the skinny man reacted very quickly and jumped away to avoid his hand.
Chen Li turned around and his eyes widened when he saw this scene, as did the other four guests.
Some of them actually know martial arts!
The servants outside the palace rushed in and surrounded him.
The skinny man no longer looked nervous as before, but showed a fierce smile. He stared at Jiang Changsheng and said with a smile: "Little Taoist priest, I didn't expect that your Taoism is so high that you can even see through my skills. It seems that you are really a genius."
Jiang Changsheng said calmly: "Your Excellency's body skills are not simple either."
The wealthy daughter stepped back and asked in horror: "Xue Hai, how come you know martial arts?"
Xue Hai smiled sadly and said: "You know me very well?"
The wealthy daughter was silent.
Xue Hai looked at Chen Li and said: "No. 1 Scholar, isn't it ironic? If the other person hadn't been a highly skilled martial artist, would you have arrested him by force, returned to the Yamen, and then convicted him casually? The Chen family has always been like this, and you were like this when the Chu Dynasty was still there. "
The Chu Dynasty was the dynasty before the Jing Dynasty. At the end of the Chu Dynasty, the eunuchs disrupted the government and the people were in dire straits. Some righteous people revolted, which led to the collapse of the Chu Dynasty and the era of feudal rule in the world. Jiang Yuan was not a nobleman, but a martial arts practitioner, but he successfully established the Jing Dynasty.
When Wu Fu became emperor, the Jing Dynasty ushered in the practice of martial arts, which far surpassed that of previous dynasties.
Chen Li frowned and asked, "Xue Hai, why did you want to kill him? "
Xue Hai did not answer, but suddenly rushed towards Chen Li at an extremely fast speed.
Jiang Changsheng didn't move because he was unhappy with Chen Li, who was trying to take him to the Yamen.
"Hmph! "
Taoist Priest Qingxu snorted coldly, stepped in front of Chen Li, raised his palm and struck with Xue Hai's right palm.
This guy can actually do palm magic, so why does he use leg magic to commit murder?
Jiang Changsheng suddenly felt that Xue Hai had deliberately framed him.
Could it be that he was bumped into by Xue Hai when he was practicing before?
After Xue Hai landed, he quickly jumped up several feet and disappeared directly outside the courtyard.
“Follow me! "
Second Brother Meng Qiuhe rushed out and shouted, and dozens of disciples immediately followed him and ran out of the courtyard.
Chen Li was so shocked that he almost collapsed on the ground.
Taoist Master Qingxu closed his palms, supported his shoulders, and said: "Almsgiver Chen, although the world is stable, there are still undercurrents. As the first champion of the Jing Dynasty, you should not move around at will. Today's disaster will have to happen again in the future. "
Chen Li thanked him quickly, and then apologized to Jiang Changsheng. Seeing his sincere attitude, Jiang Changsheng did not make things difficult for him.
The matter ended here, and Jiang Changsheng became the focus. Those disciples who were not pursuing the murderer gathered around him and asked him what martial arts he had just used. It was so fast.
Even senior brother Li Changqing and second senior brother Meng Qiuhe are also interested.
Taoist Master Qingxu said: "Changsheng, you don't need to listen to the sermons regularly from now on. You can practice martial arts on your own. Except for ringing the bell in the morning, you can set your own daily routine." "
As soon as he said this, the disciples all looked at him with envy, including Li Changqing and Meng Qiuhe. The two eldest disciples had to teach their junior brothers and sisters.
Jiang Changsheng was stunned for a moment, then thanked Taoist Master Qingxu.
Taoist Master Qingxu turned around and left, and the disciples outside the hall immediately gathered around him.
After dealing with his fellow disciples for a while, Jiang Changsheng found an opportunity to leave. Even the wealthy daughter was interested in him, and he couldn't bear it anymore.
The murder case was temporarily settled. As for whether the murderer was caught, it was none of Jiang Changsheng's business. The other disciples continued to practice as usual. He returned to his own courtyard, and he was the only one.
In Longqi Temple, there are four rooms in one courtyard, and two disciples live in one room.
Sitting on the bed, Jiang Changsheng began to organize his thoughts.
He has always been unsure whether Taoist Qingxu knew his true identity. After bringing him into Longqi Temple, Taoist Qingxu did not take special care of him. He could not ask directly.
Today's matter involved the previous dynasty. After exposing his martial arts, Taoist Master Qingxu actually gave him the greatest freedom, which made him think a lot.
[In the twelfth year of Kaiyuan, you accidentally encountered the remnant of the previous dynasty and committed an attack. You were dragged into the trouble. You relied on your ability to get out of the danger and received the survival reward - the martial arts 'King Kong Roar']
A text that only he could see appeared in front of him, making him smile.
Another disaster!
If he hadn't been practicing martial arts for six years, he wouldn't have been able to force Xue Hai to use his skills today, and he would have been arrested and taken to the Yamen, and then killed by those powerful people.
"I will still practice hard in the future and not slack off. What happened today shows that as long as there is a legitimate reason, the court can still find a way to take me out. "
Jiang Changsheng thought silently.
He also thought about something, Taoist priest Qingxu really couldn't see through Xue Hai's martial arts skills?
Anyway, he can't chooseIf you choose to believe in others, you can only believe in yourself.
After Jiang Changsheng figured it out, he began to learn the King Kong Xiao martial arts that came to his mind.
Vajra Roar is a martial art in which the true energy stimulates the meridians of the throat, making the sound extremely loud, thereby shocking the enemy. When practiced to perfection, it can also drive away evil spirits.
The word evil made him feel nervous. It seemed that there were ghosts in this world?
Yes, he has been reincarnated, so it is not surprising that there are ghosts.
In the next few days, Jiang Changsheng was bored to death. The disciples were extremely curious about him. During the day, he spent almost all his time dealing with his fellow disciples. At night, he would encounter fellow disciples peeping at him. His fellow disciple, who was one year younger than Jiang Changsheng, also pestered him. In desperation, he taught him the basic footwork of Jiuxun Tianlong Step, and then he stopped pestering him.
The days finally calmed down, and Jiang Changsheng was practicing Taoist natural skills in the house.
Clang——
Junior brother Qing Ku ran in and said excitedly: "Senior brother, the number one scholar is here again. He has promised to come and thank you. Master has agreed. He has come outside the courtyard. See you?"
Jiang Changsheng frowned and said, "If you don't see me, just say he doesn't need to thank me."
Qing Ku was stunned for a moment. He had grown up with Jiang Changsheng and still listened to Jiang Changsheng on important matters, so he nodded, turned and walked out of the house.
"Hahaha, little Taoist priest, it seems that you are holding a grudge. It was indeed me who was rude at that time. I came here to apologize and give you my Chen family's martial arts. I hope you will accept it."
Chen Li walked in with a warm smile on his face, and the eleven-year-old Qing Ku couldn't stop him.
Jiang Changsheng said helplessly: "You are also very abrupt now."
Chen Li sat down on his own, took out a gold-lined and blue-covered secret book from his arms, and placed it on the table.
"This martial art is called Qi Finger. It requires cultivating the true energy to practice it. However, our Chen family switched from martial arts to literary arts a hundred years ago. Since then, there have been no martial arts geniuses. Today, I will give it to the little Taoist Priest."
Chen Li introduced with a smile, his tone was a little hush-y when he mentioned family history.
In the martial Jing Dynasty, the Chen family had a very difficult life.
